items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Ray Nance would come in the dressing room and play with me until we went on.

ctx.x: Ray Nance was there, and Ray Nance would -- as you know, Nat would go on last. Right? Well, we have this big show with all these acts, and Ray Nance would come in the dressing room and play with me until we went on. He wouldn't play for anybody on the show but Nat.
